title: Paired Boolean update
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a type and let $\delta : \sigma \times \{0,1\} \times \{0,1\} \to \sigma$. Define a state update that, when no bit is pending, stores the input bit and leaves the state unchanged; when a bit $x$ is pending and the next input is $y$, clears the pending bit and updates the state to $\delta(s,x,y)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function taking a state and two Boolean values and returning a state
